Class NickViewController

java.lang.Object
view.NickViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
SceneController, ViewController
public class NickViewController extends Object implements SceneController
Second connection screen. Collects a nickname and tries to register it with the server. On failure, it shows the registration error. On success, the SceneRouter moves the screen view forward to the lobby view.

    • onJoin

      private void onJoin()
      Called when the joinButton is clicked. Checks the length of the inserted name (0 less than name lenght less than 21), disable the button and asks the SceneRouter to set the name.

    • onNickRejected

      public void onNickRejected()
      Called by the SceneRouter when the name registration fails. Shows the error message and re-enables the join button.
